concerns.text: FR-001 (Download OpenNeuro ds001495) and FR-004 (Generate 1,000 stories) lack verifiable implementation tasks. T014, T015, T016 (BOLD extraction) and T019 (ROCStories download) are marked '[ ]' (incomplete) or have 'FAILED' comments, leaving the core data ingestion and model generation capabilities unimplemented and untestable. The plan requires these to be executable to satisfy US-1 and US-2.

FR-001 (Extract BOLD timecourses for specific ROIs) is partially unimplemented. Tasks T014-T016 exist but are blocked by missing upstream artifacts (T012, T013) and marked as incomplete. Without these, FR-005 (RSA analysis) cannot be satisfied as the input neural data is missing.

SC-005 (Measure unique story count against target N >= 1,000) cannot be verified. Tasks T030 and T031 (Generation loops) depend on T019 (ROCStories download), which is currently incomplete/failed. The generation pipeline is broken at the data source.

FR-002 (Sparse Autoencoder sparsity constraint) and SC-001 (Sparsity ratio <= 0.20) lack a complete execution path. Task T029a (Training loop) is marked '[ ]' and depends on T019 (missing data). The verification script T026 exists, but the training task to produce the weights for verification is not actionable.

Review-Driven Refinements (T045-T048) depend on T029a (training) and T030 (generation), which are blocked by missing data artifacts in Phase 3. This creates a logical dependency dead-end; the review-driven scope cannot be implemented until the core pipeline is fixed.

Task T013 contains a malformed fallback description: 'If fetch fails, generate masks programmatically... (L/R Hipp: The research planning document defines the research question...'. This text appears to be a copy-paste error from the spec/plan, rendering the task instructions unclear and potentially unexecutable.

Task T019 and T019a are marked '[ ]' with comments 'FAILED: unspecified' and 'FAILED: unspecified'. The tasks lack clear resolution or updated instructions to proceed, leaving the ROCStories ingestion path undefined.
